scope: Exact D4 diagnostic script review; one purpose-amended diagnostic within original lifetime limits; no model execution by reviewer
findings: Captured complete firstlayer K/V prefixes and last Q are compared before interpretation of contraction results.

Query prefix slicing removes only future causal positions; finite additive padding keys are retained. Native singleton comparison hard-masks future positions and preserves original finite padding bias.

Full model calls execute unchanged genuine cached and full paths. Canonical operations run only on captured operands, with no model forward patch, reference replacement, precision change or source update.
Native batched, native singleton and canonical comparisons remain separately recorded rather than treating canonical agreement as native-model acceptance.
One bounded none/left-padding diagnostic on exposed fixtures is justified after D3; no backend search or additional candidate evaluation is implied.
interpretation_limits: If complete K/V or lastQ equality fails, shape-only contraction attribution is not established; diagnostic arithmetic may still be inspected but cannot promote a contraction-only remedy on that basis.
Raw score comparisons use pre-mask captured score tensors. Attention comparisons use post-mask outputs. Padded query rows are marked and must not be misrepresented as real-token acceptance.
DIAGNOSTIC_COMPLETE means execution completed, not all comparisons passed. Review actual row statuses.
No independently implemented policy-reference or full native-equivalence test runs here; this script cannot establish a final changed reference policy.
preserved_gates: Original native-prefill equivalence at1/8/32/128 and padding invariance remain mandatory for any changed adapter.
No stronger requirement to match both historical native modes is introduced.
Full R2 numerical,cache,boundary,top1,no-op/restoration requirements and separate exact-candidate repeat remain mandatory before R3.
next_action: Coordinator may admit this one guarded D4 after recording the purpose amendment. Original guard/resource/environment checks apply. Candidate changes need subsequent evidence-supported freeze and review.
